name: Google Flow Extension
description: Google Flow MCP workflows, fast verified batch generation and Chrome Flow tool compatibility for AntiGem WebView.

mcp_tools.name: flow_status
mcp_tools.description: Check Google Flow: opens the Flow tab if needed and reports logged_in (with the account and remaining credits), the open project, current composer settings and the job queue. If logged_in is false, tell the user to sign in to Flow in the AntiGem browser and stop.

mcp_tools.name: flow_list_models
mcp_tools.description: List the image and video model families Google Flow currently offers.

mcp_tools.name: flow_list_projects
mcp_tools.description: List the user's Google Flow projects (projectId, title, created).

mcp_tools.name: flow_create_project
mcp_tools.description: Create a new Google Flow project (direct, no generation). Opens it in the Flow tab by default, so the next flow_generate_image/flow_generate_video goes into it.

title.description: Project title (default: date/time like Flow's UI)

open.description: Open the new project in the Flow tab (default true)

mcp_tools.name: flow_rename_project
mcp_tools.description: Rename a Google Flow project.

mcp_tools.name: flow_open_project
mcp_tools.description: Open a Google Flow project in the Flow tab. Generation always goes into the project open in the tab.

mcp_tools.name: flow_get_settings
mcp_tools.description: Read Flow's current composer settings (mode, model, aspect, count) from its settings chip, without changing anything.

mcp_tools.name: flow_list_media
mcp_tools.description: List images and videos in a Flow project (mediaId, type, title, prompt, size, pending). Optional query filters by title/prompt (like Flow's search box); pending_only lists videos still generating. cached_path is set when the file is already saved locally; use flow_get_media to fetch one.

project_id.description: Project ID (default: the project open in the Flow tab)

query.description: Optional case-insensitive text to search in titles and prompts

include_trashed.description: Also list media in Flow's trash (default false)

mcp_tools.name: flow_get_media
mcp_tools.description: Get a Flow image or video as a local file (saved once in ~/flow-media; later calls reuse the same file, never copy it). Set view=true to also receive an image inline so you can look at it. To show it in chat, write ![caption](<path>) on its own line.

view.description: Also return the image inline for viewing (images only, default false)

mcp_tools.name: flow_upload_media
mcp_tools.description: Upload local image/video files into a Flow project (through Flow's own upload, so they appear in the project). Returns their new media ids, usable as references or frames. Not needed before flow_generate_*: those accept local paths directly.

project_id.description: Project to upload into (default: the open project, or a new one)

mcp_tools.name: flow_generate_image
mcp_tools.description: Generate IMAGES (not videos) on Google Flow with the user's own account. For videos use flow_generate_video. For several different prompts, pass them all at once in items (each with its own prompt and optional settings): they are sent to Flow one right after another and generate in parallel — do NOT call this tool once per prompt and wait in between. All settings are applied explicitly (defaults shown). Takes 15-30 s; images cost 0 credits on most plans. Waits up to wait_seconds; if not finished, returns job_id — call flow_get_job to keep waiting. Results are saved once in ~/flow-media; to show one in chat write ![caption](<path>) on its own line.

prompt.description: What to generate (single prompt; use items for several)

references.description: Optional reference images (variants, edits, same character): Flow media ids and/or local file paths (absolute, ~/..., or relative to the Termux home; uploaded automatically)

dry_run.description: Only build and check the request, then block it before sending (no credits); returns what would be sent

project_id.description: Project to generate in (default: the open project, or a new one)

new_project.description: Create a new project first (default false)

wait_seconds.description: Seconds to wait for all results before returning the job ids (0-50, default 45)

mcp_tools.name: flow_generate_video
mcp_tools.description: Generate VIDEOS (not images) on Google Flow — from text, from a start (and optional end) frame, or from reference images with the user's own account. For images use flow_generate_image. For several different prompts, pass them all at once in items (each with its own prompt and optional settings): they are sent one right after another and generate in parallel — do NOT call this tool once per prompt and wait in between. max_credits is the total for the whole call. All settings are applied explicitly (defaults shown). Videos cost credits: Omni 1.1 Flash 360p = 4/5/6/7 and 7500p = 7/10/12/15 for 4/6/8/10 s; Veo 3.1 Lite 10, Fast 500, Quality 100 (fixed 7500p, 8 s); times count — set max_credits to cap it. Takes about 1-5 min: waits up to wait_seconds, then returns job_id and media_ids — call flow_get_job (or flow_video_status) to keep waiting. Results are saved once in ~/flow-media; to show one in chat write ![caption](<path>) on its own line.

prompt.description: What should happen in the video (single prompt; use items for several)

start_frame.description: Optional first frame (Frames mode): a Flow image media id or a local image path (uploaded automatically)

dry_run.description: Only build and check the request, then block it before sending (no credits); returns what would be sent

references.description: Optional reference images (Ingredients mode, max 3 recommended): Flow media ids and/or local file paths. Cannot be combined with start_frame/end_frame. Not supported by Veo 3.1 - Quality

max_credits.description: Total credit limit for the whole call; prompts that would go over it are skipped before generating

project_id.description: Project to generate in (default: the open project, or a new one)

new_project.description: Create a new project first (default false)

wait_seconds.description: Seconds to wait for all results before returning the job ids (0-50, default 45)

mcp_tools.name: flow_get_job
mcp_tools.description: Get the status of one or more Flow generation jobs, waiting up to wait_seconds for them to finish. Returns local file paths when done.

job_id.description: Job ID returned by flow_generate_image or flow_generate_video

mcp_tools.name: flow_video_status
mcp_tools.description: Check Flow video generation status by media id (done / pending / failed). Finished videos are downloaded once to ~/flow-media and their paths returned.

mcp_tools.name: flow_get_last_media
mcp_tools.description: Get the newest images or videos ("the last image", "the previous 2 videos"): first the results of this session's tools, then the newest items of the project. Use the returned media_id with other flow_* tools.

project_id.description: Project to look in (default: the open project)

mcp_tools.name: flow_rename_media
mcp_tools.description: Rename an image or video in Flow.

mcp_tools.name: flow_trash_media
mcp_tools.description: Move images/videos to Flow's trash (reversible with flow_restore_media). Always confirm with the user before calling this.

mcp_tools.name: flow_restore_media
mcp_tools.description: Restore images/videos from Flow's trash.

mcp_tools.name: flow_combine_videos
mcp_tools.description: Join, trim and reorder Flow videos into one MP4 with Flow's own export (no credits). Clips play in the given order and may repeat; mixed aspects use the first clip's size. Saved in ~/flow-media; show it in chat with ![caption](<path>).

upload_back.description: Also upload the result into the open Flow project (default false)

mcp_tools.name: flow_video_to_gif
mcp_tools.description: Export a Flow video as an animated GIF (270p, no credits), saved in ~/flow-media.

mcp_tools.name: flow_extract_frame
mcp_tools.description: Save one frame of a Flow video as a PNG (done on the phone, no credits), e.g. the last frame to continue a video with start_frame. Optionally uploads it into Flow and returns its media_id.

at_seconds.description: Time of the frame (default: the last frame)

upload.description: Also upload the frame into the open Flow project (default false)

project_id.description: Target project for an uploaded frame; defaults to current project.

mcp_tools.name: flow_create_scene
mcp_tools.description: Create a Flow scene (timeline saved in Flow) from videos in the given order. For just a combined file use flow_combine_videos.

mcp_tools.name: flow_edit_video
mcp_tools.description: Edit a whole Flow video with a text instruction (Omni edit; costs credits like an Omni video of the clip length). Returns a job; the edited video is a new media item.

dry_run.description: Only check the request and block it before sending (no credits)

wait_seconds.description: Seconds to wait before returning the job_id (0-50, default 45)

mcp_tools.name: flow_edit_image
mcp_tools.description: Edit one image into a NEW VERSION of the same tile (iterations: "make the jacket red", "add a ladybug"). Works on any version of the tile (pass that version's media_id). For a separate new image based on it, use flow_generate_image with references instead. Returns a job; the result is a new media_id in the same tile.

model.description: Optional; default keeps Flow's current model

aspect_ratio.description: Optional; default keeps the current aspect

references.description: Optional extra reference images (media ids in the same project, or local file paths)

dry_run.description: Only check the request and block it before sending

wait_seconds.description: Seconds to wait before returning the job_id (0-50, default 45)

mcp_tools.name: flow_extend_video
mcp_tools.description: Continue a Veo video seamlessly with a new 8 s clip ("what happens next"); costs about one Veo video of that tier. Only for Veo clips — for Omni clips use flow_extract_frame (upload: true) then flow_generate_video with start_frame. Returns a job.

dry_run.description: Only check the request and block it before sending (no credits)

wait_seconds.description: Seconds to wait before returning the job_id (0-50, default 45)

mcp_tools.name: flow_upscale_video
mcp_tools.description: Upscale a Flow video (360p Omni → 720p; 720p videos may offer 1080p / 4K). The upscaled copy is a new media item saved in ~/flow-media. Returns a job.

wait_seconds.description: Seconds to wait before returning the job_id (0-50, default 45)

mcp_tools.name: flow_upscale_image
mcp_tools.description: Upscale a Flow image to 2K or 4K (4K may only be offered for Nano Banana Pro images). Takes about 40 s; the upscaled copy is a new media item saved in ~/flow-media.

wait_seconds.description: Seconds to wait before returning the job_id (0-50, default 45)

mcp_tools.name: flow_cancel
mcp_tools.description: Stop waiting for a queued/running Flow job (or all when job_id is omitted). A generation Flow already accepted keeps running in Flow.

mcp_tools.name: flow_lock_tab
mcp_tools.description: Lock or unlock the Flow tab for the user. When locked, the user sees an overlay on the Flow tab and cannot interact with it unless they press Unlock, which only lasts until they leave the tab (it locks again when they come back). The lock is kept across app restarts until you unlock it. While any flow_* tool is working, the tab is blocked anyway.

locked.description: true to lock, false to remove the lock

mcp_tools.name: flow_get_options
mcp_tools.description: List supported generation models, settings, limits and workflow modes.

mcp_tools.name: flow_analyze_script
mcp_tools.description: Heuristic script segmentation, entity detection, reference prompts and local-asset matching. No external LLM is called.

raw_input.description: The user's raw input: exact story text, script, bullet points, Hindi or multilingual script, or commercial brief. Strictly prioritized and preserved.

style_preset.description: Style preset based on skills: 'retro_8bit' (8-bit/16-bit arcade pixel art), 'matanyone_matting' (chroma key green screen character matting), 'gemini_multimodal' (multimodal AI director), or 'cinematic' (photorealistic 8k).

aspect_ratio.description: Target aspect ratio ('16:9' landscape, '9:16' vertical/shorts, '1:1' square).

genre_or_style.description: Optional genre or visual style (e.g. 'cinematic photorealistic 8k', 'cyberpunk sci-fi', 'luxury commercial', '2.5D anime').

protagonist_override.description: Optional explicit protagonist name or handle if requested by user.

target_scene_count.description: Optional desired scene count (auto-detected if omitted, typically 3-6 scenes).

mcp_tools.name: flow_batch_generate
mcp_tools.description: Queue up to 500 image/video prompts. Warm text-only submissions reuse verified settings. Optional bounded concurrency, pacing, pre-send retries, downloads and last-frame scene chaining. Returns a job; poll flow_get_job.

mcp_tools.name: flow_storyboard
mcp_tools.description: Analyze a script, prepare missing entity reference images and render a scene chain. Returns a workflow job; dry runs stop when a later stage needs generated IDs.

aspect_ratio.description: Target aspect ratio ('16:9' landscape, '9:16' vertical/shorts, '1:1' square).

raw_input.description: The user's raw input: exact story text, script, bullet points, Hindi or multilingual script, or commercial brief. Strictly prioritized and preserved.

genre_or_style.description: Optional genre or visual style (e.g. 'cinematic photorealistic 8k', 'cyberpunk sci-fi', 'luxury commercial', '2.5D anime').

protagonist_override.description: Optional explicit protagonist name or handle if requested by user.

style_preset.description: Style preset based on skills: 'retro_8bit' (8-bit/16-bit arcade pixel art), 'matanyone_matting' (chroma key green screen character matting), 'gemini_multimodal' (multimodal AI director), or 'cinematic' (photorealistic 8k).

target_scene_count.description: Optional desired scene count (auto-detected if omitted, typically 3-6 scenes).

mcp_tools.name: flow_character_pipeline
mcp_tools.description: Generate or upload named reference assets, persist @handles, optionally render linked video scenes. Returns a workflow job.

mcp_tools.name: flow_list_characters
mcp_tools.description: List stored named reference assets and native character tiles visible in the project.

mcp_tools.name: flow_generate_character
mcp_tools.description: Generate and name a character through Character Studio (default), or create a named image reference with native_studio=false. Returns a job. Studio dry run validates UI preparation only.

mcp_tools.name: flow_upload_character
mcp_tools.description: Upload an image once, rename the library asset and persist its reusable @handle. Does not create a native Character Studio entry.

mcp_tools.name: flow_rename_character
mcp_tools.description: Rename a persisted reference asset or a native character visible in the current page.

mcp_tools.name: flow_attach_references
mcp_tools.description: Attach existing media IDs, registered @handles or unambiguous library titles to the composer, verifying exact chip IDs.

mcp_tools.name: flow_chain_scene
mcp_tools.description: Extract the last frame of a completed video and use it as the start frame for the next prompt. Supply previous_media_id or use the most recent video.

mcp_tools.name: flow_download_media
mcp_tools.description: Download media by ID or URL into local terminal storage, with an optional filename and folder.

mcp_tools.name: flow_eval_script
mcp_tools.description: Evaluate JavaScript in the Flow page MAIN world for diagnostics. Returns its serializable result.

prompt.description: The descriptive prompt for the video generation.

reference_assets.description: Names of reference characters, hero vehicles, or images from project library to bind into the ingredient bar (e.g. ['tesla_roadster']).

reference_media_ids.description: Media IDs of character or style reference assets.

seed.description: Not selectable through the current Flow website UI. Passing seed returns an explicit error.

start_image_id.description: Media ID of start frame in Flow library (required for imageToVideo or startAndEndVideo).

raw_input.description: Alias for script_text: raw story, prompt, or script to auto-extract characters and universal entities from.

script_text.description: Optional raw script or story. If characters array is omitted, entities will be auto-detected from this script.

video_scenes.description: Optional list of sequential video scenes to generate back-to-back.

action_prompt.description: What happens in this video scene.

media_id.description: The media ID returned from deepx_generate_video.

file_path.description: Absolute local path to the image or video file.

reference_assets.description: Optional additional reference assets to stack alongside the terminal frame.
